# Barba's Painting & Services

> House painting and repair company in Hialeah, Florida, run by Danny Lopez. Registered in Florida since 2019. Rated 5.0 from 14 Google reviews. Free estimates. English and Spanish.

- Phone: (305) 555-0142
- Email: BarbasPaintingLLC@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8 am to 6 pm
- Service area: Hialeah, FL

## Services

- [Exterior painting](https://barbas-painting.vercel.app/services/exterior-painting/): Full house exteriors, trim, doors and walls.
- [Interior painting](https://barbas-painting.vercel.app/services/interior-painting/): Rooms, ceilings, trim and doors.
- [Fence painting](https://barbas-painting.vercel.app/services/fence-painting/): Metal, wood and concrete fences and gates.
- [Drywall repair](https://barbas-painting.vercel.app/services/drywall-repair/): Holes, cracks and water damage, patched and painted.
- [Pressure cleaning](https://barbas-painting.vercel.app/services/pressure-cleaning/): Walls, roofs, driveways, pavers and pool decks.
- [Stucco repair](https://barbas-painting.vercel.app/services/stucco-repair/): Cracks, chips and damaged stucco, patched to match.
- [Waterproofing](https://barbas-painting.vercel.app/services/waterproofing/): Sealers and coatings for walls and roofs.
